page_note: Dense cosmological substrate teaching: systematic mapping of four body-cosmoi each containing seven archons (head/upper, neck-to-chest, torso, lower body), correlated with sense organs and internal organs. Followed by the twelve zodiac signs bound in the sphere/wheel above the heaven. Only one editorial intrusion (seg 20: 'the Illuminator said to those who hear him'). The fatigue score drift is a false positive — second-half cosmological vocabulary actually INCREASES because of zodiac terminology. Pure substrate page.
